purpose: Machine-readable mapping from every FBL-020-R7-C1 acceptance-correction outcome to the implementation, named tests, database-control mutations, and deterministic gates that prove it. scripts/check-requirement-map.ts verifies the authority digest, id shape/uniqueness, clause coverage, that every named implementation file and test exists (tests verbatim), and that every cited database-control id exists in scripts/database-control-mutations.ts.

authority.verdict_vocabulary: PROVEN = the named tests, mutations and gates exercise the outcome and are green locally against a real PostgreSQL 16. PENDING-CI = additionally awaiting the exact-SHA ci.yml run at the corrected head. No verdict is a claim of architect acceptance.

clause_inventory.text: Clean mutation provenance: temporary PID/state outside the repository; CI hard-fails unless the runtime mutation artifact reports baseline green, zero survivors, the final commit correctly identified, and tree_dirty:false; the artifact is not merely edited.

Real runtime/migration credential separation: the API and worker authenticate as a distinct non-owner non-superuser login; it cannot RESET ROLE into owner authority, assume the evidence/migration owner, disable triggers/DDL/modify the ledger, or directly insert normalized child evidence, but can insert an authorized parent decision and cause database-owned normalization; compose/production startup fails closed on an owner credential or absent posture.

Structural authority classification: no action-name prefix determines authority; customer actions require tenant authorization and, for support, valid delegation; genuine control-plane actions are platform-scoped with no tenant and no customer resource; catalog construction rejects contradictory definitions; renaming an action cannot change its plane.

Support authority live at evidence-write time: a support ALLOW is rejected if the supporting platform role binding is revoked, disabled or out of window when evidence is inserted, even if valid at evaluation; no policy or audit ALLOW is left behind after refusal; an active-binding control passes.

Approved support scope must cover the actual resource: at write time the approved scope relates to the database-resolved resource ancestry; rooftop-A approval plus rooftop-B resource refuses; same-rooftop succeeds; a valid ancestor reaches a descendant; nonexistent and foreign resources refuse; ordinary runtime credentials cannot forge the evidence directly.

Close the system evidence bypass: actor_type='system' is not a caller-selectable escape; either system resource ALLOWs are prohibited or every one names a tenant and uses database-resolved ancestry; a system row carries no human actor, credential, support-session or delegated-support evidence; fabricated snapshots, nonexistent/foreign resources and mixed human/system evidence all refuse.

Validate the complete approval transition: the complete approval invariant is re-checked whenever a request enters or remains in approved, not only when the grant id changes; staged pending/denied-to-approved transitions cannot bypass grant/scope/ancestor/decider/timing validation; terminal transitions are constrained truthfully; a valid atomic approval passes.

Enforce retained-state upgrade requirements: the populated upgrade inspects ALL retained request/session actor and tenant tuple mismatches and identifies invalid standing approved scopes; irreparable conflicts refuse before landing with exact count and bounded identifiers, leaving history untouched and inventing no approval; a clean upgrade validates the intended constraints and converges with a fresh database.

Final verification: the 681/65 floor is preserved with zero failed/cancelled/skipped/todo; all existing gates and mutation controls preserved with non-vacuous proof for the new predicates; a green exact-SHA run at the corrected commit; a new independently verifiable packet including tree_dirty:false; canonical state and requirement records updated truthfully; external matters reported unchanged.

a support ALLOW is refused when the actor’s platform binding ages out before the write

requirements.requirement: A support ALLOW's approved scope must cover the resource it names, via the one database resource-ancestry authority.

tests.name: a rooftop-A support approval cannot authorize a rooftop-B resource
an ancestor support approval reaches a descendant resource, and a foreign resource is refused

requirements.verdict: PROVEN. Rooftop-A approval refuses a rooftop-B resource; same-rooftop and ancestor-to-descendant succeed; a foreign resource refuses; the mutation kills its test.

requirements.requirement: A resource ALLOW must name a tenant (so resolution validates the snapshot), and a system row carries no human, credential or support evidence.

tests.name: a system resource ALLOW cannot carry a null tenant and a fabricated rooftop snapshot
a system resource ALLOW that names a tenant is validated against the real resolution
a system row cannot carry human, credential or support evidence

requirements.verdict: PROVEN. A null-tenant fabricated-snapshot system row is refused; a tenant-named one is validated against the database's own resolution; human/credential/support evidence on a system row is refused; a pure system decision is the positive control. Closing the system lane also SUBSUMES two 058/059 clauses that were reachable ONLY through it, and both are handled by disclosure rather than left as silent survivors: (a) 058's binding-tenant clause, reachable only by a system row naming a cross-tenant actor_user_link_id, now refused at pd_system_row_carries_no_human_evidence before the clause — its binding_tenant_ignored mutation is retired, coverage moving to system_row_carries_human_evidence, and the reconstruction test asserts the §6 CHECK; (b) 059's resource-rooftop snapshot-presence CHECK (pd_v4_resource_allow_names_its_rooftop), inert whenever a tenant is named because the structural trigger assigns the resolved leaf before the CHECK, reachable only on the null-tenant lane §6 now forbids — its resource_allow_snapshotless mutation is retired, coverage moving to v4_structural_judge_absent and system_resource_allow_needs_no_tenant. Both 058/059 clauses remain in their migrations as immutable defense in depth (migrations ≤059 are byte-immutable). The protections are strictly stronger and earlier, not weakened.

requirements.requirement: The complete approval invariant is re-validated whenever a request is approved, closing the staged transition; terminal transitions are constrained; a valid atomic approval passes.

tests.name: a staged pending-then-approved transition cannot bypass scope validation
a request cannot become approved from a terminal state
a valid atomic approval is accepted

requirements.verdict: PROVEN. A staged approval over an archived, future or aged-out scope refuses; a terminal-state request cannot re-open as approved; a valid atomic approval is the control; the mutation kills its test. §7's scope-effectiveness message is worded DISTINCTLY from 059's identically-shaped clause (059's trg_sar_grant_is_the_approval fires first and owns the single-step path), so 059's own approved_scope_need_not_be_effective mutation stays KILLABLE — dropping 059's clause hands the defect to §7's trigger, whose different message fails the test pinned to 059's phrase — while §7 still enforces the same invariant on the staged path 059's early return skipped.
